ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious FromBase64String Usage On Gzip Archive - Ps Script
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts of decoding a base64 Gzip archive in a PowerShell script. This technique is often used as a method to load malicious content into memory afterward. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*FromBase64String.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*MemoryStream.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*H4sI.*"))
